english: He fully knows the god-traversed paths — he who, knowing thus, observes the vow of the ox.

sanskrit: jyog jīvati sarvam āyur eti na purā jarasaḥ pra mīyate yaḥ (…) ||
english: He lives long, he attains the full span of life, he does not die before old age — he who, knowing thus, observes the vow of the ox.

sanskrit: prathate prajayā paśubhir gṛhair dhanena yaḥ (…) ||
english: He spreads wide with offspring, with cattle, with houses, with wealth — he who, knowing thus, observes the vow of the ox.
